lines.en: Lesson 13
lines.zh: 第13课

lines.en: 'It's only me'
lines.zh: “是我呀”

lines.en: What did the man expect to find under the stairs?
lines.zh: 那个男人期望在楼梯下找到什么？

lines.en: After her husband had gone to work, Mrs. Richards sent her children to school and went upstairs to her bedroom.
lines.zh: 丈夫去上班后，理查兹夫人把孩子们送去学校，然后上楼到卧室。

lines.en: She was too excited to do any housework that morning, for in the evening she would be going to a fancy-dress party with her husband.
lines.zh: 那个上午她兴奋得顾不上做家务，因为晚上她要和丈夫一起去参加一个化装舞会。

lines.en: She intended to dress up as a ghost and as she had made her costume the night before, she was impatient to try it on.
lines.zh: 她打算打扮成一个鬼魂。由于头天晚上她已做好了化装服，所以她迫不及待地想试穿一下。

lines.en: Though the costume consisted only of a sheet, it was very effective.
lines.zh: 尽管化装服只是一块床单，但效果却非常好。

lines.en: After putting it on, Mrs. Richards went downstairs.
lines.zh: 穿上衣服后，理查兹夫人下了楼。

lines.en: She wanted to find out whether it would be comfortable to wear.
lines.zh: 她想看看穿上是否舒服。

lines.en: Just as Mrs. Richards was entering the dining-room, there was a knock on the front door.
lines.zh: 理查兹夫人刚走进饭厅，前门就传来了敲门声。

lines.en: She knew that it must be the baker.
lines.zh: 她知道肯定是面包师。

lines.en: She had told him to come straight in if ever she failed to open the door and to leave the bread on the kitchen table.
lines.zh: 她曾告诉他，如果她没有开门，他就直接进来，把面包放在厨房的桌子上。

lines.en: Not wanting to frighten the poor man, Mrs. Richards quickly hid in the small storeroom under the stairs.
lines.zh: 理查兹夫人不想吓着那个可怜的人，便迅速躲到了楼梯下的小储藏室里。

lines.en: She heard the front door open and heavy footsteps in the hall.
lines.zh: 她听到前门打开了，走廊里传来沉重的脚步声。

lines.en: Suddenly the door of the storeroom was opened and a man entered.
lines.zh: 突然，储藏室的门开了，一个男人走了进来。

lines.en: Mrs. Richards realized that it must be the man from the Electricity Board who had come to read the metre.
lines.zh: 理查兹夫人意识到这一定是电力公司的抄表员。

lines.en: She tried to explain the situation, saying
lines.zh: 她试图解释情况，说道：

lines.en: 'It's only me', but it was too late.
lines.zh: “是我呀”，但为时已晚。

lines.en: The man let out a cry and jumped back several paces.
lines.zh: 那个男人大叫一声，后退了几步。

lines.en: When Mrs. Richards walked towards him, he fled, slamming the door behind him.
lines.zh: 当理查兹夫人走向他时，他逃走了，并在身后砰地关上了门。
